test_apply_fn: test the transform_lib.apply_fn function to apply a transformation on input features and write output features
test_apply_filter: test the transform_lib.apply_filter function to filter examples based on a predicate on a feature
test_apply_do_fn: test the transform_lib.apply_do_fn function to apply a do_fn that yields multiple examples per input
test_remove_feature: test the transform_lib.remove_feature function to remove specified features from examples
test_rename_features: test the transform_lib.rename_features function to rename multiple features in examples
